content.text: Server computes it; I'll switch to a median and rename accordingly.

Norm is now measured against the median of everyone's scaled instead of the average. With an even number of people, it uses the lower of the two middle values. `bin/e2e` passes both tests, one with 5 people and one with 4.

**What changed:** in `src/main/java/net/officefloor/hq/app/people/PersonController.java`, `meanScaled` is now `medianScaled`. It sorts the scaled values that can be worked out and takes the middle one, or the lower middle one for an even count. People whose scaled is "n/a" are left out of the median, as they were left out of the average before.

The outlier flag and the outlier count are both worked out from norm, so they follow the new rule without any other changes. The front end only shows what the server sends, so the only change there is the description comment in `src/main/frontend/src/app/features/people/people.ts`.
